items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Little old funny place. They were Spice Brothers, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. Little old funny place. They were Spice Brothers, you know. And Alberta, Alberta, she sang one song and this other girl sang. Ruth somebody. Ruth, Ruth, yeah. Ruth and Alberta, yeah.
It might have been Ruth Lee or something like that. That doesn't sound good. Yeah.
